## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Wait until the upgrade timelock delay has fully elapsed before calling execute_upgrade.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust

let wasm = BytesN::from_array(&f.env, &[0x42; 32]);
f.client.mock_all_auths().propose_upgrade(&f.governor, &wasm, &MIN_UPGRADE_DELAY_SECONDS);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_execute_upgrade(&f.governor));
```
